scope: Keep capture audio frames alive through the complete sequence, including leading and trailing silence and wholly inaudible settings.

root_observed_native_failures: First maximum capture had a 60-second video but only 45 seconds of audio, ending with its last audible source.
Actual 6-second mono regression decoded 95040 frames against its existing 283200-frame minimum.

controlled_native_probe.interpretation: The MediaStreamAudioDestination stopped producing audio frames when its only AudioBufferSource ended. A live zero-valued ConstantSource retained the full timeline.

implementation: Create a ConstantSource only when start is explicitly called in capture mode.
Set offset to zero and connect only to the existing capture destination, starting at the existing sample-aligned audio origin.
Leave original PCM, crop, gain, source scheduling, preview routing, and export clock unchanged; allocate no extra PCM buffer.
Keep the zero source active until existing recorder/session cleanup, including silent leading and trailing time and a wholly inaudible descriptor.
Stop and disconnect the owned zero source exactly once through idempotent stop/close on completion, cancellation, or native start failure.
Refuse capture clearly when ConstantSource is unsupported while preserving preview support.

initial_red.reason: Expected failures for missing zero-source lifetime and failure cleanup; all six existing cases and preview-independence case passed.

first_integration.reason: New fixture required bit-identical results from mathematically equal scheduling expressions with different floating-point grouping: 1.5000208333333331 versus 1.5000208333333334. The fixture now permits less than two machine epsilons while preserving exact offset/duration and the existing scheduling formula.

coverage: Sample-aligned shared origin; original source crop and gain unchanged
Live zero signal after source end through sequence end; no second PCM allocation
Abort stops/disconnects immediately and awaits native context drain
Native zero-source start failure retires all owned resources

integration_status: Root owns the full project suite, exporter mock compatibility, and actual native mono/maximum re-verification. This focused receipt does not claim those gates have passed.
